plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
scope: informational only (ADR-025): no custody, no order execution, no escrow, no listings between users, no personalised advice
marketDataFeeds: none configured: the only seeded trade source in OpenVibe.Sources (SEC EDGAR XBRL filings RSS) is disabled there, and it carries filings, not prices; no observation exists until a source states one
seed: none (tests create their own instruments; production holds 0 instruments and 0 observations)
deployment: Deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy trade`: unit openvibe-trade on 127.0.0.1:4860 behind nginx; on 2026-09-23 /api/ready answered 200 with status degraded [freshness], which is honest: no feed is configured; Network OAuth client trade and its grants exist; no Events subscription; the database is empty (0 instruments, 0 observations) until editors add instruments. Public at https://openvibe.trade since 2026-10-09, after an independent pre-launch security review whose fixes shipped first; OpenVibe.Sites is deleted (plan T11) and the domain serves the service itself
features: informational only: a route-inventory test refuses any execution, custody or advice endpoint
instruments with exact, deterministic resolution (CIK, ticker, name)
observations with required timestamps; no observation, no number
per-source freshness with stale badges and transition events
SEC EDGAR filings from Sources matched to instruments
cited editor context; AI drafts need approval; advice refused
SDK outbox events and Search index documents
